description: In front of you is an open brown shelf beside a toy dishwasher, with several clear plastic food containers and a green-lidded container on the shelves and tabletop. The left hand stays low near the shelf edge while the right hand reaches into the middle shelf, un-stacks a small clear container and sets it on the table, then removes a larger rectangular container and places it to the right; next the right hand lifts out the green-lidded container and lays it on the tabletop, then pulls out the remaining clear containers from the lower shelf one by one and lines them up on the table.
